sections.heading: Description
sections.text:
Ashina Elite - Jinsuke Saze (葦名流 佐瀬甚助, Ashina School Sase Jinsuke) is an optional Mini-Boss with two Deathblow Counters.
He mostly fights with the Ashina Cross.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Upper Tower - Ashina Dojo: inside the dojo.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - As the first invasion of Ashina Castle by the Central Forces is triggered, this miniboss will disappear for the rest of the playthrough. However, the Prayer Bead that he would have dropped will still be available in the offering box next to Hanbei for 1500 1500.
